questions.question: A bar graph shows January sales of $2000, February sales of $3000, and March sales of $4000. By what percent did sales increase from January to March?
questions.explanation: January = $2000, March = $4000. Increase = $4000 - $2000 = $2000. Percent increase = (Increase / Original) × 100 = ($2000 / $2000) × 100 = 100%.
